parole.significato: With sugar and evaporated milk added.
parole.testo: Uncertain. Either from Hainanese 鮮 /鲜 (si²³, “fresh”), short for 鮮奶 (“fresh milk”), Malay cair (“melted”) referring to evaporated milk, or an abbreviation of Carnation, a canned milk brand, and historically, one of the most widespread forms of evaporated milk in Singapore.

parole.significato: A person who traces his/her ancestry to Hailam or the surrounding area, especially those that ancestrally speak Hainane…
parole.testo: From either or both Hokkien 海南 (Hái-lâm) or Hainanese 海南. Doublet of Hainan and Hainam.
